svg.text: 84 nodes · 64 relationships · 83 implied labels, generated from the LegalRuleML Core Specification Version 1.0 RDFS modules published by OASIS. The main arrows are named by their relationship type; hover any arrow for its name and description, and cards link to the term IRI.
required: every source has one or more
every source has at most one
subtype: also carries the supertype's label

path.title: HAS_AGENT: An Agent in the collection.
FROM_LEGAL_SOURCES: The LegalSources from which the Alternatives are derived.
HAS_ALTERNATIVE: An Alternative in the collection.
TO_TARGET: The target to which properties are applied by the Association.
HAS_ASSOCIATION: An Association in the collection.
APPLIES_AUTHORITY: An Authority applied by the Context or Association. Its domain is not declared: it comes from its superproperty 'applies'.
APPLIES: An entity applied by the associator.
APPLIES_JURISDICTION: A Jurisdiction applied by the Context or Association. Its domain is not declared: it comes from its superproperty 'applies'.
APPLIES_SOURCE: A Source or Reference applied by the Context or Association. Its domain is not declared: it comes from its superproperty 'applies'.
APPLIES_STRENGTH: A Strength applied by the Context or Association. Its domain is not declared: it comes from its superproperty 'applies'.
APPLIES_TEMPORAL_CHARACTERISTICS: A collection of TemporalCharacteristics applied by the Context or Association. Its domain is not declared: it comes from its superproperty 'applies'.
APPLIES_TEMPORAL_CHARACTERISTIC: A TemporalCharacteristic applied by the Context or Association. Its domain is not declared: it comes from its superproperty 'applies'.
HAS_AUTHORITY: An authority which is a member of the subject collection.
HAS_MEMBER: An entity in the collection.
HAS_COLLECTION: A collection.
HAS_LEGAL_SOURCES: Ta collection of LegalSources. Its domain is not declared: it comes from 'hasCollection', reached through 'hasSources'.
HAS_SOURCES: Ta collection of LegalSources. Its domain is not declared: it comes from its superproperty 'hasCollection'.
HAS_STATEMENTS: A collection of Legal Statements. Its domain is not declared: it comes from its superproperty 'hasCollection'.
HAS_COMMENT: A Comment on the parent Node Element.
APPLIES_ALTERNATIVES: A collection of Alternatives applied by the Context.
APPLIES_ASSOCIATIONS: A collection of Associations applied by the Context.
APPLIES_ASSOCIATION: An Association applied by the Context.
IN_SCOPE: The Statement or (collection of) Statements that the Context is applied to.
CONTENT: An entity wrapped by the subject wrapper.

AUXILIARY_PARTY: A role in a Deontic Specification to which the Deontic Specification is related. Its domain is not declared: it comes from its superproperty 'DeonticRole'. Its range is not declared: it comes from its superproperty 'DeonticRole'.

BEARER: A role in a Deontic Specification to which the Deontic Specification is primarily directed. Its domain is not declared: it comes from its superproperty 'DeonticRole'. Its range is not declared: it comes from its superproperty 'DeonticRole'.
DEONTIC_ROLE: A role in a Deontic Specification.
HAS_PARAPHRASE: A Paraphrase of the parent Node Element (e.g. a Legal Rule).
HAS_ACTOR: An Actor that has the responsibility to fulfill the function of a Figure.
HAS_FUNCTION: The function of a Figure.
HAS_FIGURE: A Figure in the collection.
HAS_JURISDICTION: A Jurisdiction in the collection.
HAS_LEGAL_REFERENCE: A LegalReference in the collection.
HAS_AGENTS: A collection of Agents.
HAS_ALTERNATIVES: A collection of Alternatives.
HAS_ASSOCIATIONS: A collection of Associations.
HAS_AUTHORITIES: A collection of authorities associated with the subject LegalRuleML document.
HAS_CONTEXT: A Context described in the LegalRuleML document.
HAS_FIGURES: A collection of Figures.
HAS_JURISDICTIONS: A collection of Jurisdictions.
HAS_LEGAL_REFERENCES: A collection of LegalReferences.
HAS_REFERENCES: A collection of References.
HAS_ROLES: A collection of Roles.
HAS_TEMPORAL_CHARACTERISTICS: A collection of TemporalCharacteristics.
HAS_TIMES: A collection of Times.
HAS_LEGAL_SOURCE: A LegalSource in the collection of LegalSources.
OVER: The Legal Rule with higher priority.
UNDER: The Legal Rule with lower priority.
REFERS_TO: The internal ID of the Reference.
REF_ID_SYSTEM_SOURCE: The IRI source of the ID system of the Reference (or of References contained by the References collection).
HAS_REFERENCE: A Reference in the collection.
APPLIES_PENALTY: The PenaltyStatement that is linked to a LegalRule in a Reparation.
TO_PRESCRIPTIVE_STATEMENT: Athe PrescriptiveStatement that is linked to a PenaltyStatement in a Reparation.
FILLED_BY: An Actor that fills the Role.
FOR_EXPRESSION: A LegalRuleML expression for which the Role is responsible (e.g., the expression was created or endorsed by the role).
HAS_ROLE: A Role in the collection.
HAS_SOURCE: A Source in the collection.
HAS_STRENGTH: The Strength of the Legal Rule.
HAS_TEMPLATE: The template of a Legal Statement.
HAS_QUALIFICATION: A qualification (e.g. an Override) of the Statements.
HAS_STATEMENT: A Legal Statement in the collection.
FOR_STATUS: The Legal Status of the qualification in a TemporalCharacteristic.
HAS_STATUS_DEVELOPMENT: The Status Development of the qualification in a TemporalCharacteristic.
HAS_TEMPORAL_CHARACTERISTIC: A TemporalCharacteristic in the collection.

g.title: Actor — An Agent or a Figure. Properties: uri
Agent — An entity that acts or has the capability to act. Properties: uri
Agents — A collection where every member is an Agent. Properties: uri
Alternative — A LegalRuleML rendering of one or more Legal Norms. Properties: uri
Alternatives — A mutually exclusive collection where every member is a LegalRuleML rendering of one or more Legal Norms. Properties: uri
Associable — An entity that can be applied to other entities. Properties: uri
Association — A partial description of the extension of some relations where each non-target entity is paired with every target entity. Properties: uri
Associations — A collection where every member is an Assocation. Properties: uri
Associator — An entity that can apply properties to other entities. Properties: uri
Atom — Properties: uri
AtomicFormula — Properties: uri
Author — Properties: uri
Authorities — A collection where every member is an Authority. Properties: uri
Authority — A person or organization with the power to create, endorse, or enforce Legal Norms. Properties: uri
Collectable — An entity that can be a member of a LegalRuleML collection. Properties: uri
Collection — Collection. Properties: uri
Collector — An entity that can have a collection. Properties: uri
Comment — A comment, which has no semantic effect. Properties: uri
Commentable — An entity that can have an attached comment. Properties: uri
Compliance — An indication that an Obligation has been fulfilled or a Prohibition has not been violated. Properties: uri
ConstitutiveStatement — A Legal Statement that defines concepts and does not prescribe behaviours. Properties: uri
Context — An application of Associations to their target entities within a Scope. Properties: uri
Creatable — An entity that can have a creation date. Properties: uri
Data — Properties: uri, symbolForData
DataWrapper — Data wrapper. Properties: uri
DefeasibleStrength — An indication that, in the absence of information to the contrary and where the antecedent of a Legal Rule holds, the conclusion of the Legal Rule holds. Properties: uri

Defeater — An indication that, in the absence of information to the contrary and where the antecedent of a Legal Rule holds, the opposite of the conclusion of the Legal Rule does not hold. Properties: uri
DeonticModality — A modality pertaining to Deontic Specifications. Properties: uri
DeonticSpecification — An Obligation, Permission, Prohibition, Right, .... Properties: uri
Editor — Properties: uri
Expression — A rendering of one or more Legal Norms or a fragment of a Legal Norm. Properties: uri
FactualStatement — An expression of fact. Properties: uri
Figure — An instantiation of a function by an Actor. Properties: uri
Figures — A collection where every member is a Figure. Properties: uri
Formula — Properties: uri
Function — Function. Properties: uri
Jurisdiction — A geographic area or subject-matter over which an Authority applies its legal power. Properties: uri
Jurisdictions — A collection where every member is a Jurisdiction. Properties: uri
LegalReference — A Reference whose Source is a LegalSource. Properties: uri
LegalReferences — A collection where every member is a LegalReference. Properties: uri
LegalRuleMLDocument — A formal representation of one or more LegalSources using the LegalRuleML Specifications. Properties: uri
LegalSource — A source of one or more Legal Norms formulated in any format and endorsed by an Authority. Properties: uri
LegalSources — A collection where every member is a LegalSource. Properties: uri

LegalStatus — A standing that can apply to a Legal Norm at a Time, e.g., "is applicable", "is in force", "has efficacy", "is valid". One of the 3 values LegalRuleML defines: `Applicable`, `Efficacious` and `InForce`. Properties: uri
LogicalFormula — Properties: uri
LogicalFormulaStatement — A statement modelled by a logical formula. Properties: uri
MetaFormula — Properties: uri

Obligation — A Deontic Specification for a state, an act, or a course of action to which a Bearer is legally bound, and which, if it is not achieved or performed, results in a Violation. Properties: uri
Override — An indication that a Legal Rule takes precedence over another Legal Rule. The ordered pair of Legal Rules is an instance in a defeasible priority relation. Properties: uri
OverrideStatement — A Legal Statement of an Override. Properties: uri
Paraphrase — A natural language rendering of a Legal Rule or fragment of it that is an alternative to its Legal Source(s). Properties: uri
PenaltyStatement — A Legal Statement of a sanction (e.g. a punishment or a correction). Properties: uri

Permission — A Deontic Specification for a state, an act, or a course of action where the Bearer has no Obligation or Prohibition to the contrary. A weak Permission is the absence of the Obligation or Prohibition to the contrary; a strong Permission is an exception or derogation of the Obligation or Prohibition to the contrary. Properties: uri
PrescriptiveStatement — A Legal Statement which prescribes behaviours, e.g. with Permissions, Obligations, or Prohibitions on states, actions, or courses of actions. Properties: uri
Prohibition — A Deontic Specification for a state, an act, or a course of action to which a Bearer is legally bound, and which, if it is achieved or performed, results in a Violation. Properties: uri

Reference — A pair consisting of an internal ID and an enriched non-IRI identifier, where the non-IRI is paired with some additional information that is sufficient to disambiguate the non-IRI to a unique Source. Properties: uri, refID, refIDSystemName
References — A collection where every member is a Reference. Properties: uri

Reparation — An indication that a PenaltyStatement is linked with a PrescriptiveStatement. It indicates that a sanction may apply where the PrescriptiveStatement entails a Deontic Specification and when there is a Violation of the Deontic Specification. Properties: uri
ReparationStatement — A Legal Statement of a Reparation. Properties: uri

Right — (see also Permission) a Deontic Specification that gives a Permission to a party (the Bearer) and implies there are Obligations or Prohibitions on other parties (the AuxiliaryParty) such that the Bearer can (eventually) exercise the Right. Properties: uri
Role — A function of or part played by an Actor relative to a LegalRuleML expression. Properties: uri
Roles — A collection where every member is a Role. Properties: uri
RuleMLWrapper — Wrapper. Properties: uri
RuleMLXMLLiteralWrapper — XML literal wrapper. Properties: uri
RuleStatement — A Legal Statement modelled by a Legal Rule. Properties: uri
Scope — A Statement or Collection of Statements. Properties: uri
Source — A source formulated in any format. Properties: uri
Sources — A collection where every member is a Source. Properties: uri
Statement — A Legal Statement or a FactualStatement. Properties: uri
Statements — A collection where every member is a Legal Statement or a FactualStatement. Properties: uri

StatusDevelopment — A kind of event (e.g., start, end) that changes the Legal Status of a Legal Norm, e.g. making a Legal Norm in force. One of the 2 values LegalRuleML defines: `Ends` and `Starts`. Properties: uri
Strength — The quality of a Legal Rule to resist or not to resist a rebuttal. Properties: uri
StrictStrength — An indication that where the antecedent of a Legal Rule is indisputable, the conclusion of the Legal Rule is indisputable. Properties: uri

SuborderList — A Deontic Specification for a sequence of Deontic Specifications, i.e., Obligations, Prohibitions, Permissions, Rights and/or Suborder Lists. When a SuborderList holds, a Deontic Specification in the SuborderList holds if all Deontic Specifications that precede it in the SuborderList have been violated. Properties: uri
Template — An entity wrapping an XML literal with root element in the RuleML or LegalRuleML namespace. Properties: uri
TemporalCharacteristic — A pair of Time with a qualification, which consists of a Legal Status and a Status Development, such that the qualification holds at the Time. Properties: uri
TemporalCharacteristics — A collection where every member is a TemporalCharacteristic. Properties: uri
Term — Properties: uri
TimeTerm — Properties: uri
Times — A collection where every member is a Time. Properties: uri
Violation — An indication that an Obligation or Prohibition has been violated. Properties: uri
WellFormedExpression — Properties: uri
Wrapper — A conceptual container. Properties: uri
XMLLiteralWrapper — A container for an XMLLiteral. Properties: uri, symbol
